descriptions.MarwanOS: Fedora/Universal Blue bootc image for PC1, a controller-only console OS with a Godot shell, gamescope session, Steam and Wine/Proton app support
descriptions.PC1: Earlier Windows-based PC1 attempt: unattended stripped Windows 11 install media, a C# host that runs as the shell, and an Electron controller UI
descriptions.pc1-shell: Godot 4 controller-first shell for PC1 (launcher, library, files, settings, on-screen keyboard) with an embedded Chromium browser built as a CEF GDExtension
descriptions.pc1-controllers: Python evdev/uinput input broker for PC1 that exclusively grabs physical gamepads and hands games a gated virtual controller
descriptions.pc1-installers: Python worker that installs and launches Windows EXE/MSI apps in managed Wine/Proton prefixes for PC1, with a C bridge that makes setup wizards controller-friendly
descriptions.pc1-services: PC1 session daemons in Python: a PipeWire audio manager and a D-Bus notification server that keeps a persistent inbox for the shell
descriptions.pc1-fdm: Fork of Free Download Manager Classic (C++/MFC, HTTP and BitTorrent) adding a full-screen XInput controller UI so it runs as a PC1 app under Wine
descriptions.mediawan: Educational self-hosted media library app (Node.js, Express, SQLite) with catalog search, download-client integration, HLS playback, subtitles and watch history
descriptions.marusic: Educational Spotify-style web player for YouTube Music, built on Node.js/Express with youtubei.js and yt-dlp, plus a PWA and a Kotlin Jetpack Compose Android client
descriptions.marwan-summakieh: Source for my portfolio site: Next.js, TypeScript and Tailwind, with a project devlog and an AI chat assistant that answers questions about my work
descriptions.storyroom: Realtime collaborative novel-writing workspace with shared TipTap editing, live cursors, scene chat and a story bible, built on Next.js, Yjs, Hocuspocus and Prisma
descriptions.Emergency-Button: Bachelor's project: React Native (Expo) app that sends your GPS location as an emergency alert, notifies nearby responders and shows danger zones on a map
descriptions.trader: Python trading bot running a monthly ETF momentum rotation on Alpaca paper trading, plus a simulated crypto instance, with backtests, a FastAPI dashboard and Docker
descriptions.envira-loss-experience: Interview task: FastAPI service that reports insurance loss experience by peril (premium, incurred loss, loss ratio, claims) in DKK, with a review UI and Docker
descriptions.envira_technical: Interview task: FastAPI service and CLI that finds a Danish asset's nearest weather station and reports its wet days and highest three-day rainfall
descriptions.real-time-video-feed-subsampling: Master's thesis simulator for prosthetic vision: turns depth video into phosphene patterns, using RANSAC floor detection or a small PyTorch model to highlight walkable space
descriptions.social_graphs_project: Network and NLP study of Elden Ring lore: a Python pipeline builds a graph from the Elden Ring Fan API, explored on an interactive Sigma.js site
descriptions.Neural-Network: Neural-network building blocks from scratch in Python and NumPy: neurons, dense layers, ReLU and softmax activations, and cross-entropy loss
descriptions.GraduationDemo: Unity 6 third-person murder-mystery prototype on a carnival train: gather clues and testimony, build theories in a notebook, then accuse a suspect
descriptions.CnCGenerals-2026-09-05_23-08-25: Neon Frontier: an original single-player RTS in Unity 6 with two factions, base building, power and supply economy, fog of war, aircraft and AI skirmishes
descriptions.Basket-Ball-VR: Small Unity VR basketball scene for Oculus headsets built with the XR Interaction Toolkit: grab the ball and shoot at a hoop
descriptions.Terminal: Minimal GUI terminal emulator in Go that runs bash in a pseudo-terminal and renders its output in a Fyne window
